description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Melissa is seeking a Software Engineer or Software Developer for its Rancho Santa Margarita, CA location. The role develops and maintains software projects involving database systems, ETL processes, web services, and back-end systems, with a focus on worldwide large address data sets, data consolidation, and data accuracy.
Software engineer building data systems, ETL pipelines, and backend services for large address datasets

Responsibilities:
• Developing and maintaining a variety of software projects related to database systems, ETL processes, web services, and back-end, with a focus on worldwide, large address data sets
• Primary focus will be on developing processes, consolidating data, and improving data accuracy
• Able to work with other teams to support and enhance existing products while applying best practices

Requirements:
• BS degree in computer science, software engineering, or related work experience
• 1+ years of experience in software development
• Proficiency with C#
• A Team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Able to work with other teams to support and enhance existing products while applying best practices
• Good time management skills and critical thinking

Preferred:
• MSSQL Server
• NoSQL databases (Cassandra, CouchDB)
• Apache Kafka
• Work in data parsing, record matching and/or database profiling
• Web Service development
• Web API consumption
• Experience in cross-platform development (Windows and Linux)
